description: This file defines the EmployeePictureDao class, responsible for data access operations related to employee pictures within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to save an employee picture and retrieve a picture by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDao
classes.description: Data access object for employee pictures, providing methods to save and retrieve employee picture entities.

methods.name: saveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Saves the given EmpPicture entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpPicture entity associated with the given employee number, or returns null if not found.
